name: Karsten S.A.
summary: Karsten S.A. manufactures and sells home textiles lines and décor products in Brazil. It offers bed linen, table linen, bath linen, atelier, and Karsten décor products. The company also provides house and decoration products, such as home fragrances, picture frame, robe, decorative pillow and blanket, organizer and clothes basket, and kitchen and bathroom accessories; and Karsten Décor fabrics, including Tramé, aquablock/waterproof, art décor, marble, and wall décor/wall fabrics, as well as fabric craft products. The company was founded in 1882 and is headquartered in Blumenau, Brazil. Karsten S.A. is a subsidiary of Kasavii Participações S.A.
